_readme: Generator manifest for the in-game /cegen command (Creative Devtools generators/GeneratorRunner) and the
optional run at game startup (config/creativedevtools-common.toml [debug.generators]).
Entries run one at a time, in this order, so put a generator after anything it reads:
gen_structure_config writes structure_config.json, which gen_structure_groups reads;
gen_structure_groups also reads biome_config.json, so it runs after both.
A failed entry is reported and the rest still run.
Fields per generator:
id        name used by /cegen run <id>
script    path from the instance root, run with the configured python from the instance root
args      extra command-line arguments (optional)
groups    /cegen run <group> runs every entry in the group; 'all' runs everything
dumps     in-game commands whose kubejs/exported/ output the script reads. /cegen run <target> dumps
runs them first; plain runs (and the startup run) use whatever the last dump left
outputs   files or folders the script writes. Hashed before and after, so chat can say what changed
apply     what makes a changed output take effect, shown only when something changed
warnExit  exit codes that mean 'finished with findings' rather than 'failed' (optional)
highlight extra regexes, on top of the top-level list, whose matching output lines go to chat
outRoot   output folder for a generator that writes Creative Delight member rows (optional; read by the
script through tools/gen_out.py, not by /cegen). Must be one of the CD trees the jar build copies,
e.g. kubejs/data/creativedelight/kubejs/<modid>; its outputs must lie under it. Missing = pack folder.
The CD jar has to be rebuilt after such a run (build_deploy refuses a stale jar). Since framework #7
(2026-11-01) cans, food types, placeable and mortar write one <mod>/<name>.js member script per item
namespace there (gen_out.write_member_scripts); their JSON in generation_scripts/food is the record only
handRun   top-level list (not read by /cegen): hand-run scripts that need an outRoot, e.g. gen_can_types.py
Every tools/*.py generator or report is either listed below or named here with the reason it is run by hand:
dump_server_mods.py: the only way to fill server_mods/ (no in-game command any more). Run it by hand before a
server release; kept out because it copies ~300 jars and refuses to run while a jar has no mod_sides.md row
build_deploy.py: stages a release
need arguments or a choice: biome_rarity_floor.py (floor values; rewrites the biome tuning), cd_move_diff.py
(snapshot / diff), decompile_mod.py, jar_diff.py, seabed_heights.py (a save), log_warnings_scan.py (a client
log), diff_block_state_ranges.py (both sides' logs), echo_texture.py, potion_bucket_texture.py and gen_lunchbox_looks.py (one-off art)
one-off rewrites of kubejs/data structures: port_structure_jars.py, lootr_fixed_containers.py
write mod resources, so a jar rebuild (not a restart) applies them: gen_bedspreads/elytra_pattern_compat.py and
gen_dd_dishes.py (Creative Delight), gen_moobloom_variants.py (More Mooblooms), gen_compost_values.py (Creative
Delight's startup tree; also needs the --merge / --add-new choice)
hand workflows run with --check first: gen_can_types.py (rewrites item_dict.js and the can tables; its outRoot entry
is in the top-level handRun list, which /cegen does not read),
gen_cfb_racks.py (Cooking for Blockheads wood racks and fridge fill, Creative Delight's blockheadsAdditions; jar rebuild)
checks that print and write nothing: effect_audit, shield_check, check_moobloom_data, check_worldgen_json,
crop_growth_coverage, wthit_icon_audit, structure_biome_coverage, leaf_path_scan, changelog_lint
libraries and tests: pack_paths (shared paths, item_dict parser, lenient json, jar locator), lang_index, gen_out,
display_delight_jar, loot_breakdown_scan, test_gen_out

handRun._note: Not run by /cegen (hand workflow, --check first; see _readme). Listed for tools/gen_out.py: its outRoot is the CD jar's startup tree.
